finding: The corrected order is executable and preserves recall, but forwarding every NOT_SURE excerpt is too permissive. Qwen3-8B also failed to extract an answer from three useful raw cases. DeBERTa correctly blocked one unsupported rewrite but cannot reject a wrong claim that is genuinely entailed by an irrelevant source.
decision: Do not ship this path in the desktop app. Keep raw-excerpt reranking before Qwen, but design a separate treatment for NOT_SURE and simplify the post-reranker extraction step before rerunning.
privacy: The public result contains aggregate counts only. Questions, excerpts, model outputs, expected answers and per-case decisions remain in the owner-private artifact.
claim_boundary: This replay uses eight already opened, outcome-selected cases and frozen retrieval output. It does not test unseen generalization, retrieval recall, a packaged desktop build or a physical swarm.
